viewer-desktop-full.png.observation: The faceted corner projects between the two wings. At the left the diagonal stairs cross the dark recessed galleries. The continuous glazed shopfront wraps around the base.

viewer-desktop-lod.png.observation: The reduced model retains the light gallery uprights and diagonal flights on the left, the faceted bay at the corner and the smaller openings on the retreating right wing. The status shows 26,692 triangles.

viewer-mobile-full.png.observation: The portrait layout shows both ends of the street frontage above the control panel. The light stair bands, darker recesses and the row of raised roof structures remain distinct at this scale.

viewer-mobile-lod.png.observation: The reduced portrait view preserves the angle between the two wings and the light horizontal levels across the corner. Individual shop-door details are too small to distinguish in this view.
